player_0.content: New plan: I failed because I ignored the "red" feedback, repeatedly guessing words containing letters already confirmed as incorrect (a, t, e, n, h, k, c, i). Specifically, after "spire" revealed 'p' and 'r' as yellow (correct letters, wrong positions) and 'i' and 'e' as red, I guessed "sprue" which still contained 'e'. My new strategy is to strictly exclude all red letters from future guesses. I will focus on placing the known yellow letters ('p' and 'r') into the remaining open slots (positions 3, 4, or 5) while using only untested letters for the rest of the word, ensuring no previously eliminated letters are reused.
